messages:
mira: Quick sync — proposing we delay the unpin of runtime 3.0 for hosted canary to tomorrow 09:00 PT and run a rollforward pattern instead of an immediate full unpin. Need SDK/QA/Runtime signoff.
kevin: +1 to delay. saw a 2-3% p99 latency bump in us-west during the last canary run, need to investigate kernel selection path.
ben: I reproduced on my local perf harness for longseq traffic. The KV-cache path behaves differently under continuous batching when runtime=3.0. small patch might mitigate.
jessica: QA can run the nightly regression on the canary set but we need the exact canary selector and sample prompts. send the route config.
lia: SDK compatibility looks clean for forward-compat APIs, but there is one behavior change in streaming chunking that could affect our JS client. adding a soft feature-flag would help.
sam: Ops: if we rollforward, we should enable the fallback routing rule A->B after 10m to auto-reroute on error spikes. Also propose reducing canary concurrency to 25% of normal to reduce blast radius.
deploybot: preflight started for canary group "canary-eu,canary-us-small"
deploybot: preflight result: eu-west PASS (telemetry healthy), us-west FAIL (p99 latency + error spike).
oncall-bot: noted: us-west error spike coincides with background GC window on a subset of hosts. tagging infra.
mira: Ben/Kevin — how confident are we that the KV-cache shim fixes the p99? can you estimate risk/time?
ben: quick patch + rebuild = ~2 hours; validated on staging but not on high qps environ. risk: medium.
kevin: alternative is to enable runtime 3.0 but with `kv_cache_mode=legacy` toggle for hosted canary; that requires a runtime rollout flag and no code change. lower risk.
lia: SDK flag plus runtime toggle = minimal customer impact. SDK team can ship a client-side guard in < 1 day and feature-flip it after monitoring.
jessica: QA can complete the regression for the reduced concurrency canary in ~3 hours if we provide sample sets and deployment manifest.
mira: Plan proposal: 1) Delay unpin to 09:00 PT tomorrow. 2) Run rollforward to runtime 3.0 with `kv_cache_mode=legacy` for canary group. 3) Constrain concurrency to 25%. 4) SDK ships soft client flag but do not enable by default. 5) Deploybot runs preflight, needs PASS in both eu & us small before widening. 6) Rollforward window 09:00-11:00, rollback cutoff 12:00. Anyone object?
kevin: LGTM from runtime side if we do the legacy kv toggle.
ben: LGTM. I will prepare the shim and a short runbook for rollback steps (how to flip kv_cache_mode back to optimized or re-pin).
lia: lia (sdk) here — I'll open a quick PR with the soft flag and a README for customers.
sam: I'll prepare the routing rule and set autoscaling thresholds to help absorb potential spikes.
jessica: QA ack — will need the manifest by 07:30 PT tomorrow to start early tests.
deploybot: ack — scheduled canary rollout for 2026-03-22T09:00:00-07:00 with tags [canary-eu,canary-us-small], concurrency=25%, runtime=3.0+kv_cache_mode=legacy. Preflight window starts T-30m.
mira: Thanks all. If preflight fails in us-west again, immediate rollback to runtime 2.14 and abort unpin. Ben will kick rollback steps.
ben: I have the rollback playbook ready and a monitoring dashboard pinned.
oncall-bot: Reminder: paging policy enabled during rollforward window. Escalation: oncall->lead-runtime->vp-eng if >5% error sustained for 5m.
mira: I'll post final notice in #eng-releases + #customer-success after QA passes. :thumbsup:
